citations.assessment: Rashi explains explicitly that Bar Ahina is the name of a sage and that he taught Rava the scriptural basis.
Bar Ahina’s explanation to Rava concerns kiddushin capable of leading to intercourse. The answer explains the wording of the verse.
The parallel passage attributes the explanation to Bar Ahina within the dispute between Abaye and Rava, followed by an objection.
The same formula introduces a different explanation to Rava, about leaving in relation to the Torah scroll. The previous paragraph supplies the practice under discussion.
